original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC GUI exposes readable, accurate system inventory for every named hardware category and that each displayed component belongs to the intended SUT configuration rather than being stale, missing, duplicated or mapped to the wrong slot.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify the BMC/SUT firmware and expected bill-of-materials/topology; authenticate to the BMC GUI; open each named inventory category; capture the complete displayed records and timestamps; collect supported read-only Redfish/IPMI inventory as corroboration; map processors, DIMMs, baseboard, PSUs, thermal devices, PCIe devices, drives and adapters to their physical identities; record unreadable, absent, duplicate, stale or inconsistent fields without editing inventory.
manual_activity: An operator must provide/approve the expected installed configuration and visually confirm the BMC GUI categories; an agent can automate supported read-only API collection and field reconciliation.
required_inputs: BMC/SUT model, serial, firmware and expected system bill of materials/topology
Complete expected field matrix for all nine named inventory categories, including slot/location rules and optional devices
BMC GUI access plus approved Redfish/IPMI resource mapping and client packages
Protected credentials, trusted TLS/host identity and allowed evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Bind all GUI and API evidence to the same BMC and SUT
Use read-only views/GETs and complete untruncated captures
Protect credentials and device identifiers according to project policy
Do not edit FRU/inventory, thresholds, power state or logs
Stop on wrong system, stale/unmapped data, incomplete category coverage or transport/auth failure; preserve discrepancies
agent_execution_scope: Collect supported read-only inventory resources for every source-named category
Parse records and compare them with the approved physical configuration
Correlate API data with operator-supplied GUI captures
Do not declare GUI correctness from FRU alone, mutate inventory, hide missing fields or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the expected BOM/topology and mandatory/optional field matrix
Approve canonical GUI-to-Redfish/IPMI property mapping and freshness rules
Review discrepancies and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool fru print` is a useful read-only subset, but `head -n 60` discards evidence and FRU records do not inherently cover all GUI processor, thermal, PCIe, storage and network categories.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the BMC GUI as the source-required surface, with complete screenshots/exports for all named categories; supplement using the platform-approved Redfish collections and untruncated `ipmitool fru print` where applicable.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All nine named inventory categories, GUI login/view, Common scope and 5/5-minute estimate remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an expected component matrix keyed by stable serial/slot/location, capture every GUI category, query matching read-only APIs, then report per-field match, absence, duplicate, staleness and cross-surface disagreement.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic expected configuration, stable identity mapping, full API corroboration, freshness evidence and per-category discrepancy reporting.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable screen is not proof that all components are correct; a short FRU listing also cannot substitute for the explicit GUI category set.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GUI labels may aggregate or omit properties exposed by Redfish, and some transient sensor/thermal fields may differ from static inventory, so the approved property map must state which values are compared.

project_override_considerations: If a category is intentionally unsupported or empty for this SKU, engineering must record that exception and the expected GUI/API representation. Proprietary BMC exports may replace individual screenshots only when they demonstrably preserve the source-required GUI category coverage.
expected_evidence: Complete GUI evidence for System, Processor, Memory, BaseBoard, Power, Thermal, PCIE Device, Storage and Network Adapters
Complete supported Redfish/IPMI raw output with timestamps
Per-component slot/serial/model/firmware mapping and match result
Missing, duplicate, stale, unreadable or cross-surface discrepancy list

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires the BMC GUI inventory across a precise category list. 'Correct' needs a supplied expected configuration but does not contradict the procedure.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The GUI view and inventory comparison are identifiable. Expected topology, access and property mapping are normal project inputs, so the hybrid case is not intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2230 Wistron-BMC-01064-V001: approve the BMC/SUT/firmware and complete expected BOM/topology; define mandatory versus optional fields and stable slot/serial identities for System, Processor, Memory, BaseBoard, Power, Thermal, PCIE Device, Storage and Network Adapters; approve GUI-to-Redfish/IPMI resource mapping, freshness/tolerance and unsupported-category representation, plus protected access/evidence rules.

review_improvement: Preserves every GUI category while preventing a truncated FRU subset or mere readability from being mistaken for complete and correct system inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: System inventory spans static FRU identity, discoverable processors and DIMMs, monitored power/thermal objects and enumerated PCIe/storage/network devices. No single generic FRU command proves all of these surfaces, and correctness cannot be established without the actual populated configuration. Because the GUI observation remains part of the source, operator evidence is required even though collection and reconciliation of structured resources can be automated. The operation stays read-only; missing package or schema data is a prerequisite rather than a DUT verdict.
